title: Unity VFX Entirely by AI (6.2 Astra)
author: KorvinNasa13
selftext:
Here’s my [previous post](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1x2tjpy/unity_vfx_entirely_by_ai_61_sol/).

I’m continuing to train AI to create VFX by building custom skills and pointing out what it gets wrong.

My current workflow:

1. Give it a reference video with a prompt like “recreate this exactly.”
2. Point out the issues and suggest techniques (shaders to use, textures, meshes) but nothing too detailed, just general direction, tutorial videos for it to break down and some custom examples of my own.
3. Save what it learned into the skills.
4. Repeat.

I don’t touch the effects manually at all. Everything is done by AI. I’m also teaching it to optimize the effects and it creates the comparison videos itself.
